title: smolagents
summary: A public Python library for building inspectable language-model agents with tools and execution choices.
intended_users: Developers building bounded agent workflows across model providers and tool environments.

design_decisions.problem_or_constraint: Coordinate models, tools, memory, execution, and monitoring without hiding agent behavior.
design_decisions.alternatives_considered: Code-based and tool-calling agents offer different capability and containment trade-offs.
design_decisions.chosen_approach_and_rationale: Use explicit agent, model, tool, memory, monitoring, and executor boundaries.
design_decisions.accepted_trade_off: More capable execution expands trust and sandbox responsibilities.
design_decisions.validation_approach: Review committed agent, tool, model, executor, memory, and monitoring tests without executing them.
design_decisions.reconsideration_conditions: Revisit interfaces when model or sandbox capabilities cannot be represented safely.

testing_strategy: Committed tests cover agents, models, tools, executors, memory, monitoring, and error paths; Finch never executes them.
security_threat: Tool execution, generated code, model output, credentials, and external providers cross trust boundaries whose controls must be evidenced, not assumed.
production_limitation: Static evidence cannot establish model quality, safe execution, provider privacy, successful tests, or runtime behavior.
technical_debt: Deployment-specific isolation and provider controls require independent review.
track_alignment_explanation: AI is essential while tools, memory, monitoring, and execution choices make the workflow inspectable and bounded.

ai_disclosure.purposes: No upstream AI-use claim; the calibration narrative was prepared without maintainer input.
ai_disclosure.review_validation: Human reference judgment froze before inference.
